description.value: Stefano's is a family-owned Greek restaurant that has operated since 1994 inside a converted 1927 warehouse building on Columbia Street in downtown New Westminster. The two-level space features a large dance floor, a street-level lounge, and live entertainment on weekends, giving it a distinctly festive atmosphere. Touring cyclists will find a broad Greek menu with gluten-friendly options and full takeout service, steps from the Columbia SkyTrain Station.

address.value: 315 Columbia Street, New Westminster, BC V3L 1A7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Stefano's is a real, actively operating Greek restaurant at 315 Columbia Street, New Westminster, with phone (604) 520-9911 and address corroborating OSM. The site explicitly advertises takeout ('Dine-In | Take-Out | DoorDash or Skip the Dishes Delivery') and the dinner menu marks numerous items as 'GF = Gluten Friendly' alongside visible vegetarian options. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; (604) 520-9911 sourced from website only, so phone contact_confirmed is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, established, and actively operating full-service restaurant since 1994 with a confirmed website, address, and current menu. A practical dining stop for touring cyclists in downtown New Westminster.
